eip8288_forward_compatibility.highlight: EIP-8288 (leanPCS): frames must be forward-compatible; primary change is removing the signature list in favor of a PROOF frame mode
Goal: users should not need to change wallets again when aggregation (EIP-8288) ships; forward-compat design is the priority over incremental devnet updates
lightclient's sketch: new PROOF frame mode where initial content is a regular signature; protocol interprets it per 8288 shape in future forks

pq_signatures_and_sphincs.highlight: PQ sigs without aggregation: even several hundred SPHINCS sigs/block is only a few MB; aggregation is for efficiency, not security — don't block shipping
Proposal: exclude calldata cost from the 100K verify gas mempool limit; large SPHINCS sigs would otherwise consume most of the budget
SPHINCS precompile debated; Nico/Sanso prefer EVM execution if leanPCS makes it cheap enough — avoid precompile if possible

max_verify_gas.highlight: EIP-8141 PR #12644 proposes raising MAX_VERIFY_GAS from 100K to 300K; Nethermind benchmarked this as balanced for PQ + DoS safety (initial target was 500K)
Toni cautions: MAX_VERIFY_GAS also sets builder critical-path work for FOCIL inclusion-list checks — final number depends on whether FOCIL is in Hegota

spec_priorities.highlight: Guru: immediate focus should be frames spec + EIP-8151 (restricted ecrecover) + EIP-8298 (SETCODEFROM); harden PQ readiness before adding more EIPs
EIP-8141 PR #12506 (set code from as default in SENDER mode) + EIP-8151 together form the full K1 retirement path alongside 7702
SSZ serialization/hashing for frame transactions raised at DevCon; lightclient considers it better in isolation but acknowledges large scope; no decision yet

testing.highlight: Mario proposes a new mempool-validation reference test format for clients to regression-test MAX_VERIFY_GAS rules; lukewarm yes from Nethermind, ethrex, Besu

focil_interaction.highlight: Daniil raises FOCIL + frames interaction as a risk; spencer and others deferring until ACDE/ACDC clarify whether FOCIL stays in Hegota

action_items.action: Post LeanPCS resources/writeup to ETH R&D so teams can evaluate fit with frames PROOF mode
Open draft PR with 8288-forward-compatible dependency frame proposal for async discussion
Switch leanSPHINCS implementations to new PQ bindings (breaking change in lean-pq-bindings PR #45)

decisions.decision: Signature list will be removed from frames; replaced with a PROOF frame mode forward-compatible with EIP-8288
SPHINCS-to-signature-list PR (lightclient's DevCon sketch) is not the target path; 8288-compatible PROOF frame mode is preferred
Two large spec changes (remove sig list / 8288 compat, and SSZ hashing decision) targeted for resolution within ~one month before end-of-year freeze

targets.target: Major frame spec changes (8288 compat + SSZ decision) — finalize before end-of-year holidays (~mid December 2026)
leanSPHINCS parameter set finalized — January 2027 deadline (likely earlier per Nico)
